title: MIPI DBI-2 display bus host controller (Type A, Type B, Type C options 1 / 3)

regs.name: CFG
regs.desc: Interface configuration (change only while STATUS.busy is 0)

fields.desc: 0 Type A (6800), 1 Type B (8080), 2 Type C option 1 (3-line, 9-bit), 3 Type C option 3 (4-line, D/CX pin)
Type C dummy clocks before the first read after a write

regs.name: OP
regs.desc: One bus transfer; writing OP commits it

regs.name: RD
regs.desc: Read data; reading RD frees it

fields.desc: a transfer is running or CSX is low

notes: csx, dcx, wrx (Type B WRX / Type A R/WX), rdx (Type B RDX / Type A E), d_o / d_oe / d_i (data bus, 16 bits, Type A / B) and scl, sda_o / sda_oe / sda_i (Type C) are the display pins; all pass through unchanged.
